evidence: Ethylcyclopentadienyl cyclohexadiene iridium Ir(EtCp)(CHD) metal-organic precursors were dissolved in a solvent of ethyl cyclo-hexane (ECH) with a concentration of 0.1 mole. The Ir(EtCp)(CHD) vapours were then carried in an Ar gas and supplied into the reaction chamber through a showerhead. A mixture of oxygen and hydrogen plasma was used as a reactant.
